name: Noam Favier
tagline: Software Engineer · Systems Architect · AI Tooling Specialist
summary: Full-stack engineer specializing in local-first AI, real-time processing, and high-performance developer tools. Founder of NF Software. I architect systems from scratch—pipelines, agents, CLIs, TUIs, memory graphs, and OS-level tooling.
summary_anon: Full-stack engineer specializing in local-first AI, real-time processing, and high-performance developer tools. Founder of an independent software company. I architect systems from scratch—pipelines, agents, CLIs, TUIs, memory graphs, and OS-level tooling.
philosophy: Local-first over cloud. Terminal workflows. Readable architecture beats clever code.

stack.tools: Docker, GitHub Actions, Neovim, Bubble Tea, sherpa-onnx, Ollama, OpenGL, Terraform, Tauri

soft.text: Bodybuilding for 5 years and physically fit

projects.title: Iris
projects.text: On-device pipeline (wake word → STT → LLM → TTS) in Go, powered by sherpa-onnx, running fully offline on Apple Silicon. No cloud dependency.

projects.title: Iskra
projects.text: Single Go binary handling AI-generated commit messages, bulk multi-repo sync, and status overviews. Successor to Zvezda, rebuilt for speed and simplicity.
projects.text_anon: Single Go binary handling AI-generated commit messages, bulk multi-repo sync, and status overviews. Successor to an earlier tool, rebuilt for speed and simplicity.

projects.title: sketchybar
projects.text: Tokyo Night-themed SketchyBar config (Lua, SbarLua) with multi-monitor AeroSpace workspace integration, live WiFi/battery/CPU/media widgets, and a custom icon font. Most-starred repo on GitHub.

projects.title: Nvim-config
projects.text: Batteries-included Neovim setup: 28 language servers wired through native `vim.lsp.config` with no `nvim-lspconfig` boilerplate, blink.cmp completion, Treesitter, Harpoon, LazyGit, Trouble diagnostics, plus Jupyter and LaTeX support.

projects.title: Mew
projects.text: Strict C11 reimplementation of `cat`: zero dependencies, full POSIX flag handling, ASAN/UBSAN-checked in debug builds. A deliberately small, correct systems tool.

academic.title: EnronBox
academic.text: Full-stack NLP research project (Flask, React, Tauri) classifying, summarizing, and detecting emotion across the Enron email corpus using transformer models (BART, DistilBERT), with GPU acceleration and Ollama-generated responses.

academic.title: Frisian Draught
academic.text: Led a 5-developer team building a Java/JavaFX application with DQN and Minimax AI agents, state management, and a multiplayer engine. Implemented reinforcement learning strategies.

academic.title: PotPotGolf
academic.text: Built 3D engine from scratch using Java/LWJGL/OpenGL with physics simulation, HDR lighting, shader pipeline, terrain rendering. Created ML agents for procedural courses with A* pathfinding validation. Won best project award.
